scene_002_book_nook.occlusion_description: A leaning oversized volume crosses the joint between open shelf bays and masks narrow rear spines.
scene_002_book_nook.title: Two-bay book nook

scene_003_pulley_frame.occlusion_description: A front hanging bucket masks the rear cross-brace; unequal pulley wheels and cable runs sit at separate depths.
scene_003_pulley_frame.title: Counterweighted pulley gantry

scene_004_dish_drainer.occlusion_description: Five inclined plates stand at increasing depths between side rails; their offset rims obscure one another.
scene_004_dish_drainer.title: Slotted dish drainer

scene_005_stair_landing.occlusion_description: Steps rise away from a side rail. Uprights and the open side of the top landing reveal distinct treads as the camera moves.
scene_005_stair_landing.title: Open stair and landing

scene_006_fruit_crate.occlusion_description: Gaps between stacked front slats reveal irregular groups of round produce behind the same foreground fence.
scene_006_fruit_crate.title: Slatted fruit crate

scene_007_surveyor_tripod.occlusion_description: Three splayed legs converge on an instrument deck. The instrument and legs occlude a separate ruled target behind the open base.
scene_007_surveyor_tripod.title: Surveyor's tripod

scene_008_bench_vise.occlusion_description: A sliding jaw, a fixed jaw and a steel-colored screw surround a tall clamped workpiece; the cross handle passes in front.
scene_008_bench_vise.title: Bench vise and workpiece

scene_009_pipe_manifold.occlusion_description: A pipe rises and crosses a rear valve bank before dropping into a lower return. Flange rims and handwheel overlap at different depths.
scene_009_pipe_manifold.title: Stepped pipe manifold

scene_010_open_drawers.occlusion_description: Three drawer fronts sit at unequal depths. An open middle drawer exposes an interior void and masks the lower drawer.
scene_010_open_drawers.title: Partly opened drawer stack

scene_011_counting_frame.occlusion_description: Four rods carry different bead groups in an open frame; a crosswise pointer sits in front of the lower rows.
scene_011_counting_frame.title: Counting frame with sliding beads

scene_012_plant_stand.occlusion_description: Plants at different heights break up the contour of two open shelves; sets of ellipsoidal leaves overlap pot rims and stems.
scene_012_plant_stand.title: Tiered propagating stand

scene_013_awning_kiosk.occlusion_description: A sloping segmented roof overhangs a front counter. Recessed display shelves and stacked packages can be seen through the opening.
scene_013_awning_kiosk.title: Striped awning kiosk

scene_014_slide_ladder.occlusion_description: A high platform connects a sloping chute in front to an open ladder behind. The chute partially hides the platform supports.
scene_014_slide_ladder.title: Ladder and playground slide

scene_015_jointed_lamp.occlusion_description: The lamp's folded arms and overhanging conical shade cross a tilted drawing board and its narrow front ledge.
scene_015_jointed_lamp.title: Articulated drafting lamp

scene_016_weaving_loom.occlusion_description: A thick textile covers only the lower part of a taut warp; a diagonal shuttle crosses the otherwise open strands.
scene_016_weaving_loom.title: Partly woven hand loom

scene_017_cycle_stand.occlusion_description: Two spoked wheels, a triangular frame and an oblique front docking brace cross at three depths.
scene_017_cycle_stand.title: Bicycle in a docking stand

scene_018_balance_scale.occlusion_description: Suspended pans form concavities on opposite sides of the pivot. The lower, nearer pan hides part of a separate weight stack.
scene_018_balance_scale.title: Two-pan balance scale

scene_019_corner_booth.occlusion_description: Perpendicular seat backs meet at a corner. The offset table top and pedestal hide separate portions of the seat and a floor stool.
scene_019_corner_booth.title: Corner booth and pedestal table

scene_020_switchback_ramp.occlusion_description: Two solid inclined runs reverse direction at a landing; their railings and central barrier overlap across the return lane.
scene_020_switchback_ramp.title: Switchback display ramp

scene_021_drum_kit.occlusion_description: A large front-facing kick drum partly hides smaller raised drums; thin stands place tilted cymbals across the upper silhouettes.
scene_021_drum_kit.title: Percussion cluster with cymbals

scene_022_picket_gate.occlusion_description: Pointed pickets and a diagonal gate brace mask a separate deep rectangular planter and its low foliage through narrow openings.
scene_022_picket_gate.title: Gate and planter

scene_023_potters_wheel.occlusion_description: The stack of tapered vessel sections sits on a broad spindle disk. Upright tools in front partially obscure a second vase on a rear shelf.
scene_023_potters_wheel.title: Potter's wheel and tool rail

scene_024_orbital_mobile.occlusion_description: A central sphere, tilted orbit hoops and satellites on crossed arms occlude one another inside a suspended frame.
scene_024_orbital_mobile.title: Mechanical orbital mobile
